measures: whether removing each day's spatially-uniform level offset -- i.e. anchoring the level to one in-AOI observation -- restores out-of-sample conformal coverage
does_not_measure: the rate itself (3 test days only); and it does not repair FortyGuard's forecast-vs-history level disagreement, it routes around it
requires: ONE trustworthy in-AOI observation. This turns the customer's own sensor from an optional examiner into a REQUIRED input -- a real change to the dependency list
verdict: ANCHORING HELPS BUT DOES NOT REACH 90 %: pooled 80.1 % (worst 52.8 %) vs 65.6 % (worst 0.0 %) unanchored. The level offset is the dominant term but not the only one -- a residual spatial-pattern drift remains. Quote the MEASURED rate.
